contentPattern.structure: single cell = Scene7 viewer URL (e.g. SmartCropVideoViewer.html?asset=...), as a link or plain text; optional poster picture above the link turns it into click-to-play

usage: Embedding a Dynamic Media Smart Crop / adaptive video viewer.
reuseGuidance: Use for Scene7/Dynamic Media viewer URLs (video, spin, zoom). For YouTube, Vimeo or social posts use the library embed block.
